title: my mall world experience
content: Bro, I’m so psyched out because I was watching TikTok and I’ve seen these people talking about mall world. I’m usually not one to believe things like that, but I’ve actually been to mall world before in a dream. I dreamed about mall world once when I was a teenager. All I remember is being chased through an infinite, empty, closed-down mall by two vampire baddies. Then, as soon as I got bit, I was at my house on the couch then I woke up suddenly. Now I’m sitting here bugging about this mall world crap after learning about it because it turns my stomach knowing that lots of people are dreaming about similar liminal things.
